lines: The Indiana Fever fell to the Golden State Valkyries 88-75 yesterday and sit at 14-10, second in the Eastern Conference.
The Fever host the Seattle Storm at home tomorrow night at 7:30 PM ET.
Indy Eleven dropped a 2-0 decision to Miami FC yesterday, moving to a 6-3-4 record.
The Indianapolis Indians travel to face the Columbus Clippers tomorrow at 7:05 PM ET.
